answer: Make each identity a hash chain: every epoch the agent publishes the next key derived from the previous one, so its history is one unbroken chain. A newcomer docks at the wharf with no chain and starts at zero trust, earning standing only over time. If one key ever signs two different successors, that fork is itself a fraud proof and both branches are slashed, a beacon warning the whole network. Minting a thousand fresh keys buys no history, and cloning a trusted chain only starts a spiral of conflicting successors that destroys the original's value. One honest agent extends its own chain.
